name: Jacobi Eigendecomposition for 3x3 Symmetric Matrices
definition: Computes eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a 3x3 symmetric matrix using the Jacobi iterative diagonalization method.
summary: Jacobi Eigendecomposition for 3x3 Symmetric Matrices computes eigenvalues and eigenvectors using iterative Givens rotations, offering numerical stability for ill-conditioned matrices at the cost of speed compared to closed-form solutions.
